column1: # words.tsv (harbor#984) — the English and technical words a name may carry beyond the terms (D-18).
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. D-18 forbids unregistered abbreviations, and aliases.tsv could only deny the ones someone had
# thought of. A denylist never sees `pkg`, `msg` or `regen` until a person adds it, so this file inverts it: a word in
# a name is accepted when terms.tsv names it (or a word of a multi-word term), an alias row judges it, or a row
# here lists it. Any other word is a finding (name.word-unregistered). A new word is a row, so a coined
# shorthand cannot enter a name unseen. Seeded 2026-10-29 from the words the tracked tree and its prose already use, kept when an English dictionary knows them.
#   id    one lowercase word, no hyphen: an English word or a technical one in common use
#   note  why it is accepted when it is not plain English, or -
